issue_request: FHIR-33395 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. additional_context: FHIR-33068 established the BiologicallyDerivedProduct.property backbone and value[x] model that FHIR-33395 expanded. source/fhir.ini actively includes biologicallyderivedproduct in the current resource list. The OO HCP 2021-11-01 Confluence minutes list FHIR-33395 as done, and no directly relevant Zulip discussion or conflicting Confluence full-text result was found. The adjacent FHIR-33396 nutrients issue was noted in the same minutes but is separate and already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current active StructureDefinition has BiologicallyDerivedProduct.property.value[x] with cardinality 1..1 and types boolean, integer, CodeableConcept, Period, Quantity, Range, Ratio, string, and Attachment, which includes the FHIR-33395 requested representations without undoing the broader FHIR-33068 model.
